title: Conversations Service State
description:
Mail arrives in threads, threads are in states, and work produced along the way
has to be found again. This service owns all three. (Runtimes: node; IDs: conversations)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

states.description: The declared state machine. Empty accepts anything

initialState.description: What a newly threaded conversation starts in

direction.description: ingest: inbound or outbound, unless the input says

state.description: transition: a fixed target, for a step that always moves the same way

stateFrom.description: transition: dotted path to the target in the input

conversationFrom.description: Dotted path to the conversation id, e.g. meta.conversationId

inState.description: actionable: which states count as work. **Required**

idleSeconds.description: actionable: only conversations untouched this long

kind.description: Artifacts: the board's word for what this is

status.description: Artifacts: the status to write, or to filter on

payloadFrom.description: put-artifact: dotted path to the part worth keeping

idFrom.description: set-artifact-status: dotted path to the artifact id

lastCount.description: Read-only: what the last pass saw

error.description: Read-only: why the last pass produced nothing
